objective: 交付可独立使用、结构清晰、经过可重复比较的最佳老药双向排序模型
task: old-drug to target and target to old-drug ranking
reference_scope: 720 drugs by 384 matched targets; deployment scope must be declared and validated against the current target registry

selection.primary: mean across seeds and development rolls of 0.35*d2t_AP+0.35*t2d_AP+0.15*d2t_R20+0.15*t2d_R20 on full old-drug risk sets
selection.complexity_rule: retain additional components only after controlled evidence of reproducible benefit; compare against a suitable capacity/extra-training control
selection.regression: Previously inspected 2023-2025 and KIRHub are regression diagnostics, not the architecture-selection set or new confirmation
selection.no_universal_best_claim: best among explicitly evaluated configurations for the declared tasks; no universal superiority claim

workstreams: reproduce simple and capacity-matched global baselines with original frozen training code
prepare earlier rolling validation and strictly dated within-assay ranking supervision
test optimization/EMA, query supervision and warm-started shared local interaction with matched controls
test one evidence-context interface if required for robust old-drug ranking; no mandatory sum of frozen legacy scores
select and refit a single deployment model using the validated protocol
export a clean model package, one inference interface, provenance and a reproducible model card
completion_requirements: current-state audit proves baseline reproduction and date-before-label/no-future-supervision contracts
multiple seeds and earlier rolling validation support the final architecture and training procedure
all retained components have an ablation or explicit role justified by evidence
fixed temporal and KIRHub regressions and material tradeoffs are reported without reselecting on test results
one documented deployment checkpoint and configuration are exported; research candidates are not silently ensembled
inference works independently of research training scripts and unnecessary experiment artifacts
registry mapping, invalid inputs, missing optional structure, output directions and reload parity are verified
active documentation points to the delivered model and distinguishes retrospective evaluation from full-fit deployment
pretraining_temporal_scope: downstream supervision cutoffs are enforced; public encoder training chronology/overlap is not certified
production_external_actions: no external deployment or publication is part of this local model delivery
